selection: Batch-integration revalidation of previously demonstrated module coverage, not new module coverage. Complete unchanged AlkitabModel, AlkitabIo and AlkitabYes2 production modules: 4 Kotlin and 39 Java sources through real Gradle/AGP Java/resource/dependency/AAR tasks, all selected modules production Kotlin compiled exclusively by Korrust. Dependencies and original test Kotlin use normal compilers. All three AAR class inventories/signatures, exact candidate source traces/staged bytes, independent Java/Kotlin consumers, 27 original Io/Yes2 JUnit tests and standalone invocation of actual AGP9.2.1 embedded D8 with strict warning-free diagnostics are checked. The Gradle library AAR task graph and standalone D8 check are separate evidence. No Android-device/full-app runtime or incremental speed claim.
